When a request asks to build, fix, change, refactor, implement, add, or extend code, invoke /fc-build-or-fix before editing: it sizes the track, small fixes stay fast, and other work researches, brainstorms, and asks the user before building. If a task grows mid-way, such as a new repository, a refactor, or a release, pause and route the new scope through /fc-build-or-fix instead of continuing inline. Use /fc-ship to push, watch CI, merge, release, and clean up, and /fc-review before pushing work that skipped the pipeline. A question that needs evidence from several places goes to /fc-research, a choice between approaches to /fc-brainstorm, and an unexplained failure to /fc-debug; answer simple questions directly. In a /goal or Copilot autopilot session, or after the user says 'you handle all', ask the user nothing; /fc-build-or-fix says how to decide alone.
